en.headline: Artists transform retired gas tanks into exhibition pieces in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: More than 20 artists rework blue LPG cylinders that once fuelled Hong Kong kitchens into contemporary works at The Bridge+ space, opening Wednesday.
body: An exhibition opening on Wednesday at The Bridge+ arts space in Sham Shui Po features more than 20 artists who have transformed retired blue LPG gas tanks into contemporary artworks.

The show, organised by Crown Gas, runs from 28 October to 8 November. Opening hours are 10am to 6pm. The venue is at 82 and 84 Apliu Street, near Sham Shui Po MTR station exit A2. An opening ceremony is scheduled for 3pm on the first day.

The organisers said the works reuse the cylinders that once formed part of everyday Hong Kong life, combining nostalgia with themes of sustainability and the Sustainable Development Goals. Visitors can see the pieces free of charge during opening hours.

zh.headline: 深水埗藝術展將退役石油氣罐變藝術品 周三開幕
zh.dek: 逾二十位藝術家把承載港人回憶的藍色石油氣罐重塑成當代作品，於The Bridge+空間展出至11月8日。
body: 深水埗鴨寮街The Bridge+人文藝術空間周三起舉辦「可持續・新燃全城」跨界藝術展，逾二十位藝術家將退役藍色石油氣罐改造成當代藝術品。
展覽由皇冠牌主辦，展期至11月8日，每日上午十時至下午六時開放。場地位於鴨寮街82及84號地下，近深水埗站A2出口。周三下午三時舉行開幕儀式。
主辦單位指作品以回收再造呈現可持續生活，結合懷舊與聯合國可持續發展目標。參觀免費。
